evidence.evidence: Unlock the exclusive Flayed Harbinger skin before Mortal Shell II launches! Simply download the free Mortal Shell II Open Beta and play for at least 30 minutes. The exclusive cosmetic skin will become available in the full game at launch. Important: • Use the same platform account for the Beta and the full game. • The skin will not appear inside the Beta. • You may not receive an unlock notification. • Progress beyond Marrow Keep to unlock the option to skip the Prologue. • Weapons, currency, Shells, upgrades, and collectibles will reset at launch. Mortal Shell II releases on August 20, 2026,
